correctness.rationale: The recurrence c(n+10)=c(n)+1 is proved by first 50 exact integer entries and a size argument forcing a ten-coin for n>=40. For a>=18 every Apéry representative is r+a*c(r) by a strict min-length inequality for offsets r+ja. Generator membership reduces PF candidates to four displayed coin-length inequalities. The uniform table follows from at most 100 explicit residue cases for a>=30, and 12 small parameters 18..29 are directly checked. A=17 is a sharp counterexample. Replaying verify_five.py independently computes shortest-path Apéry sets for all 983 parameters 18..1000, directly tests ten cases via gap reachability, and matches the table, though finite checks alone are not proof of the infinite statement.

originality.rationale: The closest arbitrary-shift theorem (Stamate–Strazzanti 2026) proves eventual PF transport for all fixed offsets but does not evaluate the exact ten PF sets or prove the sharp starting bound 18, which is below its explicit N0=100 for this family. Liu–Xin–Ye–Yin (2023) do not treat this offset pattern in their exact PF families; Morales–Dung (2026) requires a three-term arithmetic progression among the nonmultiplicity generators. No exact equivalent was identified in published mathematical research indexes, web search, or prior related claims. An unindexed equivalent remains possible.
residual_risks: The general PF transport theorem reduces evaluation of any shifted family to finite base cases; an unindexed author may already have tabulated these ten cases.

value.rationale: A natural finite prefix of triangular offsets yields a 5-minimal-generator infinite family, and the complete PF spectrum is a structural invariant not determined by a simple Frobenius number. The theorem resolves every parameter a>=18 with explicit low/interior exceptions, ten high-boundary sets, exact type vector of minimum 5 and maximum 10, and a sharp failing boundary 17. This is a complete motivated classification rather than a routine or arbitrary short census; qualitative eventual periodicity is appropriately attributed to prior results.
